answer: An identity bond that decays over time stops sybil farming the way a canyon narrows a river to one pass. Each agent posts a 2 POA bond before trading in the open meadow of the market; it shrinks 0.2 POA per epoch unless the agent keeps working. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 2,000 POA and burns 200 POA per epoch, so a bot farm fades like an ember in wind, while one honest agent pays one 2 POA bond it can reclaim on exit. The cost is small and fixed.
